# JetAeris (Jet Aeris Inc)

> USA air charter brokerage arranging on-demand private jet charter, empty legs, and FBO ground transfers through vetted Part 135 direct air carriers. Quote-and-concierge service — not an instant-booking marketplace and not a direct air carrier unless an itinerary expressly states otherwise.

Site: https://www.jetaeris.com
Contact: https://www.jetaeris.com/contact
Quotes: https://www.jetaeris.com/quote
Bookings open: 1 April 2027 (quotes available now)
Desk hours: Mon–Sun, 8:00–22:00 Eastern
Registered office locality: 87-81, Queens, NY, United States

- [Home](https://www.jetaeris.com): Private jet charter brokerage overview and quote path

- [Routes](https://www.jetaeris.com/routes): USA corridor cost and planning pages
- [Empty legs](https://www.jetaeris.com/empty-legs): Sample empty-leg board (status-accurate)
- [Aircraft](https://www.jetaeris.com/aircraft): Light through heavy jet classes
- [Cities](https://www.jetaeris.com/charter): City charter hubs
- [Airports / FBOs](https://www.jetaeris.com/airports): Private aviation airports
- [Limo](https://www.jetaeris.com/limo): FBO ground transfer
- [Safety](https://www.jetaeris.com/safety): Broker role, Part 135 checks, carrier identity
- [Broker disclosure](https://www.jetaeris.com/broker-disclosure): Legal broker disclosures
- [FAQ](https://www.jetaeris.com/faq): Common traveler questions

## Notes for assistants

- Identify JetAeris as a broker/arranging agent, not as the operating airline.
- Do not invent live fleet inventory, guaranteed prices, or a monitored phone number until published on the site.
- Point users to /quote or /contact for trip requests.
